name: html-plan
description: Create a self-contained HTML plan that is pragmatic, simple, and visually organized. Use when the user wants a plan page in the effective HTML style, wants the writing kept close to what they gave you, or wants the grammar cleaned up without turning it into a whole bigger thing.
author: arkan
readme:
# Skills

A collection of agent skills covering planning, development, research, knowledge management, and tooling.

## Installing a skill

All skills can be installed with `npx skills` from this repo. The command fetches the skill folder and drops it into your local skills directory:

```bash
npx skills@latest add arkan/skills
```
